summary: Deterministic z-harness update path: a thin /z-update host skill delegates all release-manifest fetch, version comparison, and install-mode dispatch to z_harness_cli/commands/update.py + release.py, with install.sh owning the actual symlink/tarball plugin install and atomic-swap mechanics.

entry_points.summary: Thin host wrapper; no manifest/tarball logic in prose, delegates entirely to the CLI.
Runs `z-harness update` or falls back to `python3 -m z_harness_cli update`.
Entry point: fetch manifest, compare_versions, dispatch by result (equal/newer/dev_unknown/stale).
Routes to uv upgrade, symlink update, or reinstall-hint based on detected install mode.
Downloads wheel, verifies sha256 against manifest, installs via `uv tool install --upgrade`; aborts on mismatch.
Aborts on dirty checkout; otherwise `git pull --ff-only` only. Does not refresh Claude/Codex plugin caches.
Tarball/runtime installs are never self-swapped by update; prints manifest-backed `z-harness install --force` command and exits 1.
Fetches/parses latest.json from Z_HARNESS_RELEASE_URL or DEFAULT_RELEASE_URL; rejects unsupported schema_version.
Semver / dev-SHA / PEP440 comparison producing EQUAL, NEWER, DEV_UNKNOWN, or STALE.
Create Claude Code plugin symlink to live repo.
Create Codex plugin symlink and register plugin.
Download/extract tarball and hand off to staged atomic replacement.
Stage existing install aside, move new payload into place, roll back on failure.
Build audited distributable tarball; resolves version via version.sh, runs audit-tarball.sh.
Emit z-harness version stamp JSON (sha/dirty/branch/tag) used at run_start events.

invariants: Symlink mode aborts on dirty git tree and uses git pull --ff-only; never force-merges or resets.
Tarball/runtime installs are never self-swapped by `z-harness update` / `/z-update`; update only prints a manifest-backed `z-harness install --target=<host> --force` reinstall command and exits 1.
install.sh tarball replacement is staged and atomic, with rollback to the pre-existing backup if either move fails (replace_with_staged_install / replace_two_staged_installs_atomically).
uv wheel upgrade verifies sha256 against the manifest before installing; mismatch aborts with exit 1.
Newer manifest schema_version than SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION (1) is a hard error, never a silent proceed.
harness_updated-style version stamps come from scripts/version.sh (sha/dirty/branch/tag), independent of the update CLI's own version comparison.
No auto-update without an explicit `z-harness update` / `/z-update` invocation; MCP `z_update` tool is read-only.
gotchas: As of the 2026-06-29 SKILL.md rewrite, symlink-mode update no longer refreshes the Claude Code plugin cache or re-runs `codex plugin add` after `git pull --ff-only` — only install.sh's install path (not update) touches the Codex marketplace file. Hosts loading from a versioned plugin cache may not pick up the update without a manual restart or a manual `codex plugin add z-harness@personal`.
Claude Code loads from a versioned plugin cache, not necessarily the live repo symlink.
A tarball containing .git would be classified as a symlink install by _detect_plugin_install (checks .git existence + payload shape before runtime/-only tarball heuristic).
install.sh --legacy is deprecated and transitional (copies frozen scripts/export-*.py exporters; symlink mode is a no-op since the symlink already exposes them).
SKILL.md intentionally contains zero manifest/tarball logic; any behavior change belongs in z_harness_cli/commands/update.py, z_harness_cli/release.py, or install.sh — not in the skill prose.

The given source_file list from callers historically omitted z_harness_cli/commands/update.py and z_harness_cli/release.py even though they now hold nearly all update behavior; this refresh added them.
